mapper.select: select count(distinct tsd.sign_word_id) from test_session_detail tsd join test_session ts on tsd.test_session_id = ts.test_session_id where ts.member_id = #{memberId} and tsd.is_correct = 'Y'
select coalesce(round(avg(ts.correct_count / ts.num_of_question) * 100), 0) from test_session ts where ts.member_id = #{memberId} and ts.ended_date is not null and ts.num_of_question > 0

select activity_date from ( select date(tsd.answer_date) as activity_date from test_session_detail tsd join test_session ts on tsd.test_session_id = ts.test_session_id where ts.member_id = #{memberId} union select date(rcl.reg_date) as activity_date from recognition_confirm_log rcl where rcl.member_id = #{memberId} ) dates order by activity_date desc

select coalesce(nullif(sw.choseong, ''), '기타') as choseong, count(distinct sw.sign_word_id) as totalCount, count(distinct case when learned.sign_word_id is not null then sw.sign_word_id end) as learnedCount from sign_word sw left join ( select distinct tsd.sign_word_id from test_session_detail tsd join test_session ts on tsd.test_session_id = ts.test_session_id where ts.member_id = #{memberId} and tsd.is_correct = 'Y' ) learned on learned.sign_word_id = sw.sign_word_id group by coalesce(nullif(sw.choseong, ''), '기타') order by field(coalesce(nullif(sw.choseong, ''), '기타'), 'ㄱ','ㄲ','ㄴ','ㄷ','ㄸ','ㄹ','ㅁ','ㅂ','ㅃ','ㅅ','ㅆ','ㅇ','ㅈ','ㅉ','ㅊ','ㅋ','ㅌ','ㅍ','ㅎ','기타')
